crossRefs.note: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all…
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will…
“I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to…
I will set up shepherds over them, who will feed them. They will no longer be afraid or dismayed, neither will any be…
“ ‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out…
I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be…
I, Yahweh, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be…
He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God: and they…
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal…
For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God…
Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk…
But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.
He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all…
My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
